gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-odia: Starborn spreads its letters out into dreamy, wide-spaced air. Anek Odia sits beneath in sans-serif, with open-hooked curves and capitals barely taller than lowercase, so a larger heading over modest body text feels right.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-armata: Dreamy and ethereal, Starborn floats its letters far apart with a heavy dark band of lowercase. Armata follows in sans-serif, with generous gaps between characters and rounded shapes that stay open, so paragraphs move along without crowding.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-carrois-gothic: Wispy, spaced-out heading letters, then a tidy modern body. Starborn gives the hazy mood, and Carrois Gothic keeps its tall x-height and open c readable beneath it.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Starborn's most striking trait is the dark lowercase band running through each line. It dreams in wide-spaced display letters, while Carrois Gothic SC handles everyday text in sans-serif, with open curves and capitals hardly rising above lowercase.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-chivo: Starborn drifts across the line in wide-spaced, dreamy letters with a dark lowercase band. Chivo, in sans-serif, handles the plain talking.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-chocolate-classic: Dreamy and hazy, Starborn lets its letters float apart with a dark lowercase band. And Chocolate Classical Sans grounds it with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and lowercase filling most of the letter height. Starborn does the dreaming, with wide gaps between letters, while Comme does the steady, practical work of carrying text in sans-serif.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads openly, its wide-eyed e and prominent x-height easy on the eye. Starborn is the dreamier one, a wire-bent display heading with wide gaps, while Cossette Texte does the quiet sans-serif work of holding the text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-funnel-sans: Starborn drifts in with ethereal, widely spaced letters and a thick dark lowercase band. Funnel Sans then keeps every stroke uniform and its e open like a pried clasp, so a long page moves smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-gafata: Starborn stretches its dreamy, ethereal letters wide, with a heavy band of lowercase running through each line. Gafata sits below, tall and wide-eyed, grounding the mood.
